description: Start a Trailersite advert for the signed-in user as a draft; it never publishes. The first call, without draftId, saves the draft and returns a link for the user to open on their phone, where they add at least 3 photos, check the advert and tap Publish themselves. Call again with draftId for where it has got to: a fresh link while it waits for photos or the user's tap, or the advert's link once they have published it. Needs the user to connect their Trailersite account.

attributes.description: Facts about the trailer or caravan, as the seller gave them. Only those that apply to its section are accepted.

category.description: Section: Touring caravans, Car transporters, Box trailers, Horse trailers, Motorbike trailers, Utility and camping trailers, Tipper trailers, Catering trailers, Boat and jet ski trailers, Livestock trailers, Plant trailers, Flatbed trailers, Trailer tents.

city.description: Town or city the trailer or caravan is in.

description.description: What the trailer or caravan is, its condition and what comes with it, in the seller's words.

draftId.description: The draftId a previous call returned. Leave out to start a new draft.

itemCondition.description: New or used. Defaults to used.

priceGbp.description: Asking price in pounds. A price outside the site limits is refused with the limit.

name: publish_listing
title: Draft an advert
